memberOmissions.name: Finalize
memberOmissions.reason: Swift deinit is non-public lifetime syntax and not a callable member

parameterLabels.constructors: class constructor labels preserve CLR metadata names; value-type constructor external labels are _
parameterLabels.methods: first external label is _; later labels preserve CLR metadata names

primaryAssociatedTypeMapping: CLR interface generic parameters map to same-named Swift primary associated types
protocolWitnessMapping: A public Swift conformance witness forced by a CLR explicit interface implementation is compiler-measured through sourceOrigin and excluded from the concrete type member count
arrayMutationMapping: CLR caller-owned destination arrays named destinationArray or corners map to Swift inout Array; source arrays remain value snapshots
enumerableMapping: System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<T> parameters map to Swift Array<T>
nullableMapping: System.Nullable<T> maps to Swift T?; ref/out direction remains independently mapped to inout
throwsMapping: Swift throws is LANGUAGE_MAPPING and does not add an XNA member
inheritedPublicMemberProjection: A selected public inherited member may be declared on a partial Swift subtype until its XNA base exists; the verifier requires an exact ancestor identity. System.IDisposable maps to a public Dispose() member.
nestedTypeMapping: replace CLR + nesting separator with Swift . nesting

systemInterfaceMappings.System.IEquatable`1: Equals/operator members; no Swift Equatable conformance required
systemInterfaceMappings.System.IDisposable: Dispose member; no public helper protocol
